answer: In the PoA graph, each validator’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so sustained honest service is required to retain influence. EigenTrust matrix factorization, tempered by reciprocity-weighted transitivity, assigns a freshly spawned sybil near-zero eigenvector centrality; an isolated island cannot affect consensus, while coordinated identities form no trusted prism or gale of endorsements without established peers and therefore cannot pass consensus.
